items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Mezzrow brought him in and introduced him to me and I told him, and I said where do you live

ctx.x: You called the dance Knee Drops when you dropped to your knees and come back up again, you know. And I guess that's where Louis got the idea from. Because they really Louis' Knee Drops and that other thing. That boy told me that was in the Smithsonian Institute. Old Gene Krupa used to love that tune. Because he was living on Riverside Drive and he had that record.
When was that, do you remember?
